codeReview.summary: The trace/trace.c file has been successfully rewritten as a thin lifecycle shim that forwards to ish_instrumentation_* functions. The implementation removes all startup markers, ring persistence, recovery logic, backend policy, environment configuration, and proof scaffolding as required. The file was reduced from ~1400 lines to ~366 lines (net reduction of ~700 lines). Legacy event emission API is preserved as stubs for kernel compatibility (task.c, exec.c, mmap.c cannot be modified per mission boundaries).

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker correctly used weak stubs (__attribute__((weak))) for ish_instrumentation_* functions, allowing the real implementation from ISHInstrumentationBridge.mm to override them at link time. This is a clean pattern for handling optional app-layer dependencies from C code.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: trace/trace.c lines 47-64: Weak stubs for ish_instrumentation_bootstrap, ish_instrumentation_activate, ish_instrumentation_is_active, ish_instrumentation_record_event, ish_instrumentation_begin_interval, ish_instrumentation_end_interval

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker correctly replicated the origin enum and attribute struct definitions locally in trace.c rather than including ISHInstrumentationBridge.h. This avoids circular dependencies and keeps the trace layer self-contained while maintaining type compatibility.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: trace/trace.c lines 30-44: Local typedefs for ish_instrumentation_origin_t and ish_instrumentation_attribute_t that match the bridge definitions

sharedStateObservations.observation: The AGENTS.md mission boundaries explicitly forbid modifying kernel/task.c, kernel/exec.c, and kernel/mmap.c. The worker correctly preserved all legacy trace_emit_* functions as stubs to maintain compatibility with these unmodifiable files.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: trace/trace.c lines 190-447: All trace_emit_* functions are stubbed with (void) parameter casts, ensuring kernel code can still compile and link

sharedStateObservations.observation: The worker correctly identified that trace_config_from_env should not be defined in trace.c since trace_config.c was retired. The function is commented as 'defined in trace_config.c' which contains a tombstone.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: trace/trace.c line 179: Comment '/* trace_config_from_env is defined in trace_config.c */'

sharedStateObservations.observation: The implementation follows the validation contract VAL-TASK3-002 requirement that trace.c be 'a small lifecycle shim forwarding to ish_instrumentation_* with no startup markers, persistence, recovery, or backend policy.' All removed functionality is either stubbed or delegated to the app layer.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Commit diff shows 366 insertions(+), 1079 deletions(-) with all heavy logic removed and replaced with forwarding calls
